m.operators_within_5km, m.operators_confirmed_within_5km, m.wtr_sites_within_5km, m.microwave_backhaul_sites_within_5km, m.operator_data_status, a.pcon_code, a.pcon_name, a.laua_code, a.laua_name, t.elevation_mean_m, t.elevation_range_m, l.blocked AS los_blocked, l.obstruction_m AS los_obstruction_m, l.los_class FROM CD_CELLS.cells_r7 c LEFT JOIN CD_OOKLA_MOBILE.ookla_mobile_r7 o ON o.cell_id = c.cell_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cell_id, to_json(collect_list(named_struct('quarter', quarter, 'download_mbps', download_mbps, 'tests', tests))) AS history_json FROM CD_OOKLA_MOBILE_HISTORY.ookla_mobile_history_r7 WHERE cell_id = '871943b9bffffff' GROUP BY cell_id ) hst ON hst.cell_id = c.cell_id CROSS JOIN ( SELECT sum(download_mbps * tests) / sum(tests) AS neighbour_download_mbps, sum(tests) AS neighbour_tests, count(*) AS neighbour_cells_with_data FROM CD_OOKLA_MOBILE.ookla_mobile_r7 WHERE cell_id IN ('871943aa6ffffff', '871943ab4ffffff', '871943ab5ffffff', '871943b98ffffff', '871943b99ffffff', '871943b9affffff') ) nb LEFT JOIN CD_MASTS.masts_r7 m ON m.cell_id = c.cell_id LEFT JOIN CD_OFCOM_AREA.ofcom_area_r7 a ON a.cell_id = c.cell_id LEFT JOIN CD_TERRAIN.terrain_r7 t ON t.cell_id = c.cell_id LEFT JOIN CD_LOS.los_r7 l ON l.cell_id = c.cell_id WHERE c.cell_id = '871943b9bffffff'
